description: Ostrun reference authentication service: email/password and Google sign-in, cookie sessions, RS256 JWTs with a JWKS endpoint.

env.name: Jwt__SigningKey
env.description: RSA private key (2048+ bits) as base64-encoded PEM, generate one per instance. Its public half is served at /auth/.well-known/jwks.json

env.name: RabbitMq__Host
env.description: RabbitMQ host. If absent, events publish over the in-memory transport (no broker required standalone)

env.name: Google__ClientId
env.description: Google OAuth client id. Set together with Google__ClientSecret to enable Google sign-in

env.name: Google__ClientSecret
env.description: Google OAuth client secret. Set together with Google__ClientId to enable Google sign-in

env.name: Auth__TrustedOrigins
env.description: Comma-separated origins (e.g. https://app.example.com) the browser may be sent back to after social sign-in. Paths on this service's own host are always allowed

env.name: Auth__TrustedProxies
env.description: Comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of the gateway/reverse proxy (e.g. 172.16.0.0/12). Only their X-Forwarded-Proto/Host/For headers are used, to build public OAuth redirect URIs and record client IPs. Unset: forwarded headers are ignored
